claim.claim-text: 1. Air vent for a vehicle, comprising a housing (12) with an inlet opening (22) and an outlet opening (24), a housing wall (16, 18) of the housing (12) delimiting an air duct (20) for air flowing from the inlet opening (22) to the outlet opening (24) along a main flow direction (H), further comprising at least one air guide element (40, 40') arranged in the air duct (20) upstream of the outlet opening (24),

at least one projection (32, 34) is formed in the area of the outlet opening (24), said at least one projection (32, 34) projecting into the air duct (20) at an angle (A, B), so that the cross-sectional area of the air duct (20) decreases in the main flow direction (H), the at least one air guide element (40, 40') being adjustable between two end positions and, at least in one of the end positions, being configured to direct the air flowing through the air duct (20) from the main flow direction (H) in the direction of the at least one projection (32, 34), wherein the at least one projection (32, 34) forms a first part of a housing wall, which is arranged at an angle relative to a second part of the housing wall adjoining the first part upstream, wherein the at least one air guide element (40, 40') is adjustably arranged in the air duct (20) so that by suitably positioning the air guide element (40, 40') the air flowing through the air duct (20) can be directed from the main flow direction towards the at least one projection (32, 34), wherein the at least one air guide element (40, 40') is designed such as to deflect the air flow from the main flow direction in particular in a direction that is perpendicular to the main flow direction, so that the air flow is directed towards the at least one projection (32, 34) so that the housing wall forming the at least one projection (32, 34) in turn deflects the air flow in another direction.

2. Air vent according to claim 1, wherein the housing wall having said at least one projection (32, 34) is configured to make possible an air deflection, in particular, a reliable air deflection - similar to the air deflection effected by an arc-shaped housing wall.

3. Air vent according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the at least one projection (32, 34) is configured such that, in a case where the air flow is directed towards the at least one projection (32, 34), an air cushion consisting of one or more air vortices is created in the at least one projection (32, 34) formed by the housing wall, wherein - because of the air cushion forming in the at least one projection (32, 34) - the air flow directed in the direction of the at least one projection (32, 34) by the at least one air guide element (40, 40') is guided so that a deflection angle of the outflowing air is achieved.

4. Air vent according to claim 3, wherein - because of the air cushion forming in the at least one projection (32, 34) - the air flow directed in the direction of the at least one projection (32, 34) by the at least one air guide element (40, 40') is similarly guided as when striking an arc-shaped housing wall, but a larger deflection angle of the outflowing air is achieved.

5. Air vent according to one of claims 1 to 4, wherein the at least one projection (32, 34) projects into the air duct (20) at an angle of 40° to 120°, preferably 60° to 100°, particularly preferably 90°.

6. Air vent according to one of claims 1 to 5, Wherein the air duct (20) has a rectangular cross-sectional area, mutually opposite housing walls (16, 18) delimiting the air duct (20) in the area of the outlet opening (24) each forming a projection (32, 34) projecting into the air duct (20) at an angle.
7. Air vent according to one of claims 1 to 6, wherein the at least one projection (32, 34) is formed by a baffle (14) delimiting the outlet opening (24).
8. Air vent according to one of claims 1 to 7, wherein the at least one air guide element (40, 40') is exactly one air guide element (40, 40'), in particular exactly one air guide slat.

9. Air vent according to one of claims 1 to 7, the at least one air guide element (40, 40') is at least one first air guide element, which deflects the air flowing through the air duct (20) from the main flow direction (H) in a first direction extending at right angles to the main flow direction (H), at least one second air guide element (50) being provided upstream or downstream or above or below the first air guide element (40, 40') to deflect the air flowing through the air duct from the main flow direction (H) in a second direction at right angles to the first direction.

10. Air vent according to one of claims 1 to 9, the at least one air guide element (40, 40') is arranged at a distance from the outlet opening (24) which corresponds at least to the height of the air outlet opening (24).
11. Air vent according to one of claims 1 to 10, a baffle plate (42, 42') standing in the air stream is arranged downstream of the at least one air guide element (40, 40').
12. Air vent according to one of claims 1 to 11, the at least one air guide element is at least one air guide slat (40) mounted in the housing such that it can be pivoted relative to the air stream.

13. Air vent according to claim 12, wherein, for the pivotable mounting in the housing, the at least one air guide slat (40) has a bearing shaft (41) arranged at an air guide slat end located downstream or at an air guide slat end located upstream.
14. Air vent according to one of claims 1 to 11, wherein the at least one air guide element is at least one air guide slat (40') that can be displaced at right angles to the main flow direction.

15. Air vent according to one of claims 1 to 14, wherein an operating strip (26) extending in particular over the entire width of the outlet opening (24) and having an operating element (28) for adjusting the at least one air guide element (40, 40') is provided in the area of the outlet opening (24).
